newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest raises airline stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest raises airline stocks.

text.p: NatWest Securities said it upgraded several airline stocks to buys.
-- raised AMR Corp, UAL Corp and Delta Air Lines Inc to buy from hold.
-- boosted Southwest Airlines Co, US Airways Group Inc and Alaska Air Group Inc to buy from accumulate.
-- the NatWest analyst was not immediately available for comment.
-- in a report, analyst Susan Donofrio said "our short-term view to sit on the sidelines is now over. We believe that good news is on the horizon to end the airlines' lackluster stock performance."
-- cited expectation of strong fourth quarter year-over-year earnings growth for group.
-- said uncertainty over changes to federal excise tax ended with budget agreement between Congress and White House.
-- said "we believe that the carriers will be able to make up for the increase in taxes through domestic and/or international fare increases."
-- said airline stocks typically lag in summer months but should start to move upward in the fall.
-- said strong international performance offsetting slow-down in domestic revenue.
-- said jet fuel prices should not impact airline stocks.
